reporting_limits: Full-field/controller basal qualification and separate polarity eligibility are audited independently. Challenged rings are not required to become stationary.
Paired reaction creation is roundoff-zero; signed cap export and global return remain distinct native model terms. Their identity does not prove what sets activity timing.
All features use actual physical ring labels and native variable cells. Activity-vector direction is not a material velocity or migration law.
Finite-window returns, differences between methods and two timesteps do not establish a converged period, unique numerical-source causality or continuous-cap closure.
An unqualified preparation, ineligible preparation or execution failure remains explicit; missing response evidence is never replaced by another branch.
